name: kailasa
description: KAILASA's internal marketplace of skills, plugins, agents, commands, hooks and MCP servers for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: codex-subagent
plugins.description: Delegate coding, analysis, and review tasks from Claude Code to OpenAI Codex agents via the codex CLI's headless exec mode, with explicit sandboxing, structured JSON output, and resumable multi-turn threads.

plugins.name: database-schema-visualizer
plugins.description: Build an interactive, explorable database schema map (pan/zoom canvas, per-table detail, search, cluster filtering) from Prisma/Diesel/SQL schemas or design docs, and publish it as an artifact.

plugins.name: push-satsang
plugins.description: Pre-chunk and upload satsang transcript file(s) into the SPH_Satsangs_v3 vidyakosha dataset

plugins.name: email-deliverability
plugins.description: Send bulk email through Kailasa Mailer that passes Google's bulk-sender rules, and test and improve Gmail Primary vs Promotions placement, using lessons from a 75-email placement study.

plugins.name: suno-download
plugins.description: Download a Suno song (song link, clip id or cloudfront m4a URL) as a playable MP3 via the public clip API and ffmpeg, with an in-browser playback-capture fallback for clips that have no downloadable video.
